There are three '''Moonwells''' in [[Ashenvale]]. [[Shael'dryn]]'s moonwell {{co|53|46|Ashenvale}} is located in the northern  part, east of [[Iris Lake]] and west of [[Raynewood Retreat]]. The southern moonwell {{co|60|72|Ashenvale}} is located west of [[Silverwing Outpost]] and southeast of [[Greenpaw Village]]. The former is oft visited by [[Alliance]] adventurers who are following the {{quest|Raene's Cleansing|Raene's Cleansing}} quest chain, and the latter is sometimes visited by [[Horde]] [[shaman]]s doing their {{quest|Call of Water|Call of Water}} quest chain. The third moonwell is located at Raynewood Retreat {{co|59|59|Ashenvale}}.
